resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Range[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Right, time to take a deeper dive into ranges!

If [b]range [/b]is called with one argument, it’ll produce an object with values from 0 to that argument. 

If it’s called with two arguments, it’ll produce values from the first to the second.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3097"]numbers = list([b]range[/b](3, 8))
print(numbers)[/code]
[note]Remember, the second argument is not included in the range, so [b]range(3, 8)[/b] won’t include the number 8.[/note]

resolved.title: for 循环
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]for Loops[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Let’s come back to the [b]for [/b]loop for a moment, because it’s great friends with range. It’s commonly used to repeat some code a certain number of times, which is done by combining for loops with [b]range [/b]objects. Like this:[code format="py" codeId="3926"][b]for [/b]i in [b]range[/b](5):
  print("hello!")[/code]
[note]Don’t worry about calling [b]list [/b]on the [b]range [/b]object when it is used in a [b]for [/b]loop, because it isn't being indexed, so a list isn't needed.[/note]

content.description: 写一个程序输出所有有洗手间的楼层。
content.title: range 应用

resolved.title: 洗手间所在楼层数
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设一栋大楼在每五层的位置有洗手间。
例如，一栋12层的大楼在5楼和10楼都有洗手间。

写一个程序，楼层数作为输入，输出所有的洗手间所在楼层数。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Ranges[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A group of buildings have restrooms on every [b]5th[/b] floor.
For example, a building with 12 floors has restrooms on the 5th and 10th floors. 

Create a program that takes the total number of floors as input and outputs the floors that have restrooms.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
23

[b]Sample Output[/b]
5
10
15
20

[note]You can define a range with the corresponding rules and output the numbers in that range.
Remember, that [b]range(a, b)[/b] includes [b]a[/b], but does not include [b]b[/b].[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
你可以用相应的规则定义一个范围，并输出该范围内的数字。
记住，**range(a, b)** 包括 **a** ，但不包括 **b** 。

code_templates.solution_code:
n = int(input())
nums = list(range(5,n+1,5))
for x in nums:
	print (x)
